statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. Let n = len(points) and, for each 0 <= i < n, let d(i) = max(abs(points[i][0]), abs(points[i][1])). For each byte c, let R_c be the nondecreasing list of all d(i) with s[i] = c. If at least one byte c has len(R_c) >= 2, let L be the minimum over all such c of R_c[1], the second smallest element of R_c with multiplicity. Then r equals the number of indices i with 0 <= i < n and d(i) < L. If no byte c has len(R_c) >= 2, then r = n.
